visualCharacteristics.purpose: pricing plan cards: optional tab label, tier heading, short description, feature list (bullet or icon items), price group pinned to the bottom, and primary button plus secondary link

contentPattern.structure: one row per plan card; optional first cell = short tab label shown above the card; main cell = optional eyebrow link, heading, description, list of features, "Starting at" label, price (e.g. $0), fee notes, button(s) and links

usage: Plan comparison grids (2-4 plans) on product, offer and home pages. Use `centered` when tier label, heading and price are centred.
reuseGuidance: Use for any priced plan/tier comparison. For product cards with a photo use cards-product; for generic cards use cards.
